statement: State an isolation claim as the mechanisms actually tested, not as isolation. Before calling it fixed, try the variants of the attack, not only the instance a reviewer reported. 2026-11-09, #687, my own error, a second time in one PR: after round 2 I recorded that an empty package.json in a fresh directory stops npm walking up to $RUNNER_TEMP. I had tested one plant, a parent .npmrc plus node_modules/pnpm. Round 3 broke the claim twice. A parent package.json declaring workspaces made npm adopt $RUNNER_TEMP as its project, and npm exec put every ancestor node_modules/.bin ahead of PATH, so a planted node ran pnpm. Fix (#687 dcb7a63fc): install pnpm with npm install --prefix and run it by path, with no npm exec. The CHANGELOG lists exactly what is still shared. The validator compares the whole runs: section. Tested against all three plants at once.
